from PIL import Image

"

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
The home screen looks good visually.

The logo is too large at 149px wide. Content overflows the viewport and hides the scan button below the fold. The media query forces the collection to scroll while home actions remain fixed.

The desktop viewport likely exceeds the 3/4 aspect ratio threshold. The shell becomes a tall phone column inside a wide window. The home screen overflows the entire shell height. This causes the whole page to scroll and pushes the buttons below the fold.

The sticky actions only apply on portrait. The desktop phone column is tall enough to scroll. The larger logo pushed the buttons below the fold. I will extend the home screen overflow pattern to the desktop phone column so actions stay visible.

Shrinking the logo is another option. The current approach is to make the home screen a flex column that fills the stage. The collection area will shrink so the actions stay visible. This extends the existing phone behavior to the desktop shell.

The desktop shell is also constrained by its padded root height. The overflow fix will be applied by default rather than only inside the portrait media query. The collection area will flex to fill available space and scroll independently. The home actions will stay fixed at the bottom.

Sticky positioning is unnecessary once the home screen hides overflow. The empty progress bar is expected at zero points. The scrollbar on the phone frame will disappear once the overflow fix is applied. I will re-screenshot after correcting the layout.

I will test the signup flow next. I will verify the leaderboard and a narrow viewport. I may use CDP emulation to resize the browser. The home layout fix comes first.
</details></think>
